title: Record every payment in a Google Sheet
summary: When Paystack confirms a payment, add a row to your sales ledger sheet.
description: Keeps your books up to date without typing: every successful Paystack payment adds a row (date, reference, customer email, amount in naira, channel) to the Google Sheet you choose.
